items.headline: Colorado State visits Texas State in Pac-12 matchup
items.description: Colorado State (2-3) at Texas State (2-3), Oct. 15 at 8 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Colorado State DC leaves sideline, fired after game
items.description: Colorado State coach Jim Mora said defensive coordinator Tyson Summers was "no longer with the program" after he was relieved of his playcalling duties in the first half and left the sideline.

items.headline: Atkinson and Legree team for big passing day in Oregon State's 56-26 win in Pac-12 opener
items.description: — Braden Atkinson threw five touchdown passes, three to Jesse Legree, and Oregon State defeated Colorado State 56-26 on Saturday in the Pac-12 opener for both teams.

items.headline: Colorado State hosts Oregon State in Pac-12 matchup
items.description: Oregon State (2-2) at Colorado State (2-2), Oct. 3 at 6 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Owen McCown passes for 303 yards and 3 TDs as UTSA beats Colorado State 59-45
items.description: — Owen McCown passed for 303 yards and three touchdowns, Will Henderson III and Brandon High Jr. each rushed for a score, and UTSA beat Colorado State 59-45 on Saturday.
